jobText:
Senior Machine Learning Research Scientist
Parallax AI Research · Remote (worldwide) · Full-time

Parallax AI Research trains open foundation models for scientific discovery. Our team works from anywhere in the world.

What you'll do
- Lead research on pre-training and post-training of large language models.
- Design and run large-scale training experiments on thousands of GPUs.
- Publish your work and present it at top conferences.

Requirements
- PhD in machine learning, computer science or a related field, or equivalent research experience.
- First-author publications at NeurIPS, ICML or ICLR.
- 5+ years of machine learning research experience.
- Deep expertise in PyTorch or JAX.
- Experience with large-scale distributed training (FSDP, DeepSpeed or Megatron).
- Strong Python.

Nice to have
- Experience with RLHF or other preference-optimization methods.
- Writing custom CUDA or Triton kernels.

Location: remote, worldwide. We hire through an employer of record in most countries.
